To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The study identified and quantified a consumer-oriented attribute list of 41 attributes of importance when evaluating theme parks.
consumers visiting theme parks are concerned with the quality of the experience, which is a combination of the quality of the attractions and entertainment and the quality of the service.

the seven key factors identified in our study are as follows: 1. entertainment variety and quality, 2. courtesy, cleanliness, and safety and security, 3. food variety and value, 4. quality of theming, 5. availability and variety of children's activities, 6. quality and variety of ride and attractions, and 7. pricing and value.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of guest experiences at theme parks.
the development of a conceptual framework for understanding the guest experience in theme parks and the identification of the key attributes of theme parks that are important to consumers.
the identification and evaluation of the key attributes of theme parks that contribute to the overall guest experience.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this study has identified and documented the most important factors that influence the guest experience when visiting a theme park.
the theme park industry has been a major success story for the last 20 years and will continue to be so.
this paper has provided an empirical evaluation of a number of important guest experience factors that influence theme park visitation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the study identified and documented consumer-oriented attribute inventory to evaluate theme parks.
the study identified and documented an attribute inventory for evaluating the guest experience at a typical theme park and identified the key factors that are important in evaluating a theme park.
we identified and documented a set of key attributes that consumers consider important when evaluating theme parks and the guest experience.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the theme park industry is not a homogeneous market.
theme parks need to focus on the quality of the experience they provide to their guests.
the theme park experience is a complex one and that it is important to understand how different elements of the experience contribute to the overall experience.
